# Helper function

```{r}
#helper functions
get_abstract_via_scopus_api <- function(doi, api_key) {
  
  doi_clean <- gsub("^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/", "", doi)
  search_url <- "https://api.elsevier.com/content/search/scopus"
  
  search_resp <- tryCatch({
    request(search_url) %>%
      req_headers(
        "X-ELS-APIKey" = api_key, 
        "Accept" = "application/json"
      ) %>%
      req_url_query(query = paste0("DOI(", doi_clean, ")")) %>%
      req_perform() %>%
      resp_body_json()
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Scopus Search request failed: ", e$message)          
    return(NULL)   })      
  
  if (is.null(search_resp)) return(NA_character_)   
  
  entries <- search_resp$`search-results`$entry      
  
  if (is.null(entries) || length(entries) == 0) {          
    message("DOI not found in Scopus search.")         
    return(NA_character_)   
  }      
  
  raw_id <- entries[[1]]$`dc:identifier`
  scopus_id <- NULL
  id_type <- "scopus_id"
  
  if (!is.null(raw_id)) {
    scopus_id <- gsub("^SCOPUS_ID:", "", raw_id)
  } else if (!is.null(entries[[1]]$eid)) {
    scopus_id <- entries[[1]]$eid
    id_type <- "eid"
  }
  
  if (is.null(scopus_id) || nchar(scopus_id) == 0) {
    message("Could not extract a valid Scopus ID from search results.")
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  abstract_url <- paste0("https://api.elsevier.com/content/abstract/", id_type, "/", scopus_id)
  
  abs_resp <- tryCatch({
    request(abstract_url) %>%
      req_headers(
        "X-ELS-APIKey" = api_key, 
        "Accept" = "application/json"
      ) %>%
      req_perform() %>%
      resp_body_json()
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Abstract Retrieval request failed for ", id_type, " ", scopus_id, ": ", e$message)          
    return(NULL)   
    })      
  if (is.null(abs_resp)) return(NA_character_)     
  
  abstract_text <- abs_resp$`abstracts-retrieval-response`$coredata$`dc:description`
  
  if (!is.null(abstract_text) && nchar(trimws(abstract_text)) > 0) {
    return(trimws(abstract_text))
  } else {
    message("Abstract field is empty in Scopus record for ID: ", scopus_id)
    return(NA_character_)
  }
}



get_pubmed_abstract <- function(doi) {
  search_res <- entrez_search(db = "pubmed", term = paste0(doi, "[aid]"))
  if (length(search_res$ids) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  xml_data <- entrez_fetch(db = "pubmed", id = search_res$ids[1], rettype = "xml")
  doc <- read_xml(xml_data)
  abstract_node <- xml_find_all(doc, "//Abstract/AbstractText")
  if (length(abstract_node) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  return(paste(xml_text(abstract_node), collapse = " "))
}

get_abstract_ss_authenticated <- function(doi, api_key) {
  url <- paste0("https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:", doi, "?fields=title,abstract")
  
  res <- tryCatch(
    GET(
      url,
      add_headers(
        "x-api-key" = api_key,
        "User-Agent" = "R-Research-Script/1.0"
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(res)) return(NA_character_)
  
  if (status_code(res) == 429) {
    retry_after <- as.numeric(headers(res)[["retry-after"]])
    wait_time <- if (!is.na(retry_after) && retry_after > 0) retry_after else 2
    
    message(paste("Rate limited (429). Waiting", wait_time, "seconds..."))
    Sys.sleep(wait_time)
    
   return(get_abstract_ss_authenticated(doi, api_key))
  }
  
  if (status_code(res) != 200) {
    warning(paste("HTTP Error:", status_code(res), "for DOI:", doi))
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  data <- tryCatch(
    fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  abstract_val <- data$abstract
  
  if (!is.null(abstract_val) && 
      length(abstract_val) > 0 && 
      !is.na(abstract_val) && 
      nchar(trimws(abstract_val)) > 0) {
    return(as.character(abstract_val))
  } else {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
}
```


# Scraping Loop

```{r}

folder_path <- here("01_data/inital_raw_database_downloads/abstract_scraping", "")
#replace with wherever your folder is

no_abstract_filenames <- list.files(paste0(folder_path, "empty")) %>%
  grep(., pattern = "_empty.csv", value = TRUE) %>%
  gsub("_empty.csv", "", .) 



for(j in 1:length(no_abstract_filenames)){
  
  if(file.exists(paste0(folder_path, "filled/", no_abstract_filenames[j], 
                        "_filled.csv"))) next
  
  start.time <- Sys.time()

  no_abstracts_batch_j <- read.csv(paste0(folder_path, "empty/", 
                                          no_abstract_filenames[j], "_empty.csv")) %>%
    mutate(source = NA)

  for(i in 1:nrow(no_abstracts_batch_j)){
  
    if(!is.na(no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"abstract"])) next
   
    #first pubmed
     pubmed_try <- tryCatch({
          get_pubmed_abstract(no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"doi"])
        }, error = function(e) {
          return(NA)
        })
  
        if(!is.na(pubmed_try) && pubmed_try != ""){
         no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"abstract"] <- pubmed_try
         no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"source"] <- "pubmed"
         next
        } 
     
     
     #next crossref
      crossref_try <- tryCatch({
          cr_abstract(doi = no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"doi"])
            }, error = function(e) {
              return(NA)
            })
                
          if(!is.na(crossref_try) && crossref_try != ""){
            no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"abstract"] <- crossref_try
            no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"source"] <- "crossref"
            next
          } 
    
    #next semantic scholar
   ss_try <- tryCatch({
                get_abstract_ss_authenticated(
                    doi = no_abstracts_batch_j[i, "doi"], 
                    api_key = semantic_scholar_api_key
                  )
                }, error = function(e) {
                  return(NA_character_)
                })
        Sys.sleep(1)
  
          
          if (!is.null(ss_try) && length(ss_try) > 0 && !is.na(ss_try) && 
              nchar(trimws(ss_try)) > 0) {
            no_abstracts_batch_j[i, "abstract"] <- ss_try
            no_abstracts_batch_j[i, "source"]   <- "SS"
            next
          }
    
    #then scopus
     scopus_api_try <- tryCatch({
          get_abstract_via_scopus_api(no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"doi"], elsevier_api_key)
        }, error = function(e) {
          return(NA_character_)
        })
       Sys.sleep(1) 
  
        if(!is.null(scopus_api_try) && length(scopus_api_try) > 0 && 
           !is.na(scopus_api_try) && nchar(trimws(scopus_api_try)) > 0){
         no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"abstract"] <- scopus_api_try
         no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"source"] <- "scopus"
         next
        } 
  
    
    #last ditch openalex
      openalex_try <- tryCatch({
          oa_fetch(
            entity = "works",
            doi = no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"doi"],
            verbose = TRUE,
            abstract = TRUE
            )
        }, error = function(e) {
          return(NA)
        })
  
      if("abstract" %in% names(openalex_try)){
  
        no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"abstract"] <- openalex_try %>%
          filter(!is.na(abstract)) %>%
          slice(1) %>%
          pull(abstract)
       no_abstracts_batch_j[i,"source"] <- "OpenAlex"
       next
      }
      
  }
  
  write.csv(no_abstracts_batch_j, paste0(folder_path, "filled/", no_abstract_filenames[j], "_filled.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
  
  end.time <- Sys.time()
  time.taken <- end.time - start.time
  
  print(paste0(no_abstract_filenames[j], ": ", round(time.taken, 3), " ", units(time.taken), " with ",
               no_abstracts_batch_j %>%
                  filter(is.na(abstract)) %>%
                    nrow(.), 
               " missing abstracts"))
  beep(3)
}

```
